command: llvm-mc -triple=x86_64 -filetype=obj research/evidence/experiments/EXP-0069/fixture.asm -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: All eight 0.40.0 rows, twice each at displacements 200 and 100000, sixteen instructions and 124 bytes: the unprefixed %rsp rows are seven bytes (8b 84 24 c8 00 00 00 / 89 84 24 c8 00 00 00), and the REX.B (%r12) and REX.R rows are eight (41/44/45 ...). This is the mod = 10 SIB shape: ModRM = 84, SIB = 24, and the signed disp32 at [24,32] or [32,32] behind a REX byte. The base is fixed in the template, so %rsp and %r12 differ only in REX.B. input_sha256 is fixture.asm (the source above); output_sha256 is the 124-byte .text.
